correctness.rationale: Unordered deleted-product cells (91,252,168) have rank(d1)=90; independently reconstructed signed boundaries and rank(d2 mod 3)=154, with rank 153 mod2. Inspected original integral Smith algorithm performs 153 unit unimodular reductions and residual rank-one gcd2, giving H1=Z^8⊕Z/2 and H2=Z^14; no longer dimension. The graph-cycle projection is G-equivariant and of full rank 8. Independently enumerated 336 Fano collineations and dualities and the signed cell Lefschetz traces; obtained degree-2 character and E=H2-W with character inner product 1 and orthogonality to W. The exact integral certificate plus rational character argument supports a distinct irreducible rational six and cycle eight.
residual_risks: A mod-prime rank alone would not prove the full integral Smith factors; that argument was separately inspected.
No integral decomposition of G-module H2 is asserted.
